$description: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Rule ids equal schema/semantic_validate.GRAPH_RULE_IDS (verify_all checks parity). Each rule was checked against templates/templates.json node sequences when written.

rules.rule: First node is shell.nav-layer; last is shell.site-footer unless the template is footerOptional (work/feed index render no footer at >=1200).
At most one HERO node; every template except heroless ones (contacts) has exactly one.
The HERO is the first body node after the nav layer.
onePerPage / maxPerPage constraints from each contract.
The same (section, variant) may not repeat back to back unless the contract is repeatable (legal clauses).
Adjacent body nodes of the same category warn, except CONTENT chains (chapters/quotes) and the numbers->awards proof pair on home.
faq.questions-answered, editorial.read-more and navigation.case-teaser sit directly before the footer.
Retrieval-ineligible runtime UI (cursor, trail, clock, tickers, menu, lightbox, form success) is never a node.
content.pull-quote directly follows a content.marked-chapter (case studies and posts).
content.legal-clause nodes are contiguous and directly follow hero.legal-header.
At most 4 nodes with continuous motion (marquee-loop, auto-scroll-columns, video-autoplay, slideshow-autoplay).
